title: ChatTf: A Knowledge Graph-Enhanced Q&A System for Mitigating Factuality Hallucinations
abstract: We build a knowledge graph of traditional folklore using LLM-based zero-shot triplet extraction. A dual-stage retrieval-augmented generation pipeline combines vector retrieval with knowledge chunk reranking. On the TFCQD dataset the system reaches 96.7% accuracy for question answering.

title: KG-CF: Knowledge Graph Completion with Context Filtering under the Guidance of Large Language Models
abstract: We label reasoning paths with an LLM and distill an LSTM sequence classifier that filters irrelevant paths. A BERT model trained on the filtered paths ranks candidates for knowledge graph completion. Experiments on FB15k-237, WN18RR and NELL-995 show improved MRR and Hits@10 for link prediction.

title: Knowledge Graphs: Opportunities and Challenges
abstract: This survey reviews knowledge graph embedding methods such as TransE and graph neural networks. We compare embedding models on FB15k, WN18 and WN18RR for link prediction using MRR. Knowledge graphs support question answering, recommendation and information retrieval.

title: Automated Knowledge Graph Construction for Intelligent Research Information Systems
abstract: We use SciBERT for named entity recognition and transformer classifiers for relation extraction over 1.5 million documents from OpenAlex, arXiv and PubMed. Entity precision exceeds 90% and authorship relation extraction reaches 95.4% F1.
